records.verbatim: Cooking Instructions: All appliances vary, the following are guidelines only. For best results, microwave cook. To Microwave Cook: Remove sleeve and pierce film in several places. Place onto a microwavable plate and heat on full power for 4 minutes 30 seconds (900W) or 5 minutes (800W). Remove from microwave and peel off film carefully. To Oven Cook: Preheat oven to 190°C/170°C Fan/375°F/Gas Mark 5. Remove sleeve and pierce film lid in several places. Place on a baking tray in centre of preheated oven and cook for 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven and peel off film lid carefully. Allow to stand for 1 minute. Stir well and serve. Caution: Container will be hot. Take care with pack as it may become flexible during heating. Beware of escaping steam when removing film. Ensure product is piping hot throughout prior to serving. Do not reheat.
